questions.question: What is the dealership name, location, and preferred visual identity (logo, colors, or overall style)?
questions.answer: Share details in the text field
questions.rationale: The brand and market location shape the site identity and local messaging.

options.label: Share details in the text field
options.description: Provide the dealership name, location, and any logo, color, or style direction.

questions.recommendedChoice: Share details in the text field

questions.question: Which language should the dealership website use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is a strong default for a multi-page website with searchable inventory and an admin interface.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a maintainable, typed web application.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use JavaScript without static typing.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: React is a practical default for the requested pages, filters, vehicle details, and admin dashboard.

options.label: React
options.description: Recommended for a responsive, interactive dealership site.

options.label: Next.js
options.description: React framework with routing and server-rendering options.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a preferred framework.

questions.question: Are there any additional pages, content, or customer-facing features beyond the requested home, about, contact, vehicle listing/detail, search/filter, and WhatsApp/call enquiries?
questions.rationale: This captures any must-have content or interaction not already included in the request.

questions.question: Which language should the inventory and admin API use?
questions.rationale: C#/.NET is a well-supported Azure backend option for inventory CRUD and authenticated administration.

options.label: C# (.NET)
options.description: Recommended for a production-ready API on Azure.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Use a TypeScript-based API.

options.label: Python
options.description: Use a Python-based API.

questions.question: Which backend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: ASP.NET Core aligns with the recommended C# API language.

options.label: ASP.NET Core
options.description: Recommended for a secure, maintainable .NET API.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a preferred backend framework.

questions.question: What vehicle fields, inventory workflows, or integrations are required (for example, status, pricing, mileage, photos, CSV import, or a third-party inventory feed)?
questions.rationale: The vehicle schema and data-ingestion path determine the inventory API and storage needs.

questions.question: Which data stores should the application use? Vehicle records need persistent storage, and vehicle photos need file storage.
questions.rationale: The inventory admin requires a database, and vehicle listing pages are expected to store and serve photos.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Relational database for vehicle records and admin-managed inventory.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational database alternative for vehicle records and inventory.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store and serve vehicle photos and other media.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Choose only when the app needs no persistent records or file storage.

questions.question: Should users sign in to access application API features, including the vehicle-management admin dashboard?
questions.rationale: The requested admin dashboard needs protected access even though public vehicle browsing remains open.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require authenticated access to protected API features and administration.

options.label: No
options.description: Do not require user sign-in for application API features.

questions.question: Who should be able to manage vehicle listings, and do you have an existing sign-in system that should be used?
questions.rationale: Admin ownership and any existing identity system affect the access model.

options.label: One dealership owner/admin account
options.description: A single authorized person manages inventory.

options.label: Multiple staff accounts
options.description: Several staff members need separate admin access.

options.label: Existing sign-in system
options.description: Use an identity system already in place; provide details.

questions.question: What phone/WhatsApp number, email, address or service area, and business hours should appear on the site?
questions.rationale: These details power the contact page and direct call and WhatsApp enquiry links.

options.label: Share available contact details
options.description: Provide the public phone/WhatsApp number, email, address or service area, and hours.

questions.question: Where should the website and API be hosted, and do you have an Azure subscription or existing hosting constraints?
questions.rationale: Hosting preference and subscription availability guide the deployment design.

options.label: Azure
options.description: Recommended for the Azure-guided setup and integrated hosting options.

options.label: Existing hosting
options.description: Keep the current provider; provide its name and constraints.

options.label: Other cloud provider
options.description: Use a different cloud provider; provide details.

options.label: Undecided
options.description: Recommend an appropriate hosting approach.
